grilling.description: Challenge a plan, a decision or an idea through rounds of questions before implementing it.

codebase-design.description: Vocabulary of deep modules: interface, seam, depth; interface design in several variants.

prototype.description: Throwaway prototype to settle a design, logic or interface question.

tdd.description: Test-first development: red, green, refactor; integration tests preferred.

diagnosing-bugs.description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions: reproduce, minimize, hypothesize, instrument, fix.

writing-for-agents.description: Write documents intended for agents: skills, AGENTS.md, repo docs.

investigation.description: Research on primary sources, recorded in a Markdown file in the repo, delegated to a background agent.

mr.description: Write a merge request description: visual summary, evidence, merge risk.

routing.description: Which command, which tool and what level of ceremony for the situation: kit router.

grill-me.description: Tight interview to sharpen a plan, with no repo and no written record.

grill-with-docs.description: Tight interview that feeds GLOSSARY.md and the ADRs as answers come in; entry point of the main flow.

to-questionnaire.description: Turn a decision you cannot make alone into a questionnaire for someone else.

to-spec.description: Turn the conversation into a specification published on the ticket tracker.

to-tickets.description: Split a plan or a spec into tracer-bullet tickets with their blocking dependencies.

wayfinder.description: Map a piece of work too large for one session into decision tickets, resolved one by one.

implement.description: Implement a ticket or a spec, with TDD, then review.

implement-spec.description: Implement a whole spec: tickets read as a graph, sub-agents in parallel, integration branch.

code-review.description: Review of a diff from a fixed point on two axes: repo standards and compliance with the spec.

ticket-sorting.description: Move incoming tickets through a triage state machine until they are ready for an agent.

retrospective.description: Retrospective of a work session: improve the agent's environment, not the code.

handover.description: Compact the conversation into a handover document for another agent or another session.

wait-what.description: Rephrase the last message that was not understood, using the glossary's vocabulary.

zoom-out.description: Step back: wider context and big picture.

teach.description: Learn a perimeter or a concept over several sessions: lessons, quizzes and briefs; shared material in the repo's docs/learn/<topic>/, personal progress in ~/.ai-kit/learning/.

improve-codebase-architecture.description: Find the modules to deepen, HTML report, then an interview on the ones selected.

manual-steps.description: Generate an interactive bash wizard for the steps only a human can perform.

write-a-skill.description: Create a skill: structure, progressive disclosure, resources.

writing-great-skills.description: Reference for writing and reviewing predictable skills.

setup-workflow.description: Configure a repo for the flow: ticket tracker (GitHub, GitLab, local), triage labels, location of the glossary and the ADRs. Run once per repo.

workflow-guide.description: Which skill or which flow for the current situation: router across all skills.

init-project-context.description: Set up a repo's agent context, with confirmation for each file: short AGENTS.md, prefilled GLOSSARY.md, REVIEW.md, git rule for artifacts; does not copy the templates, does not create an empty ADR.

python-js-change.description: Develop or review a Python or JavaScript feature in an existing repo.

sql-review.description: Review BigQuery or dbt SQL and investigate suspicious aggregations, duplicates or business results.

dbt-model-change.description: Create, modify, test or document a dbt model on BigQuery.

bigquery-query-review.description: Optimize a slow or expensive BigQuery query and check scans, partitions, joins and plan.

kpi-definition.description: Define a KPI before computing it: grain, population, period, exclusions, source of truth, owner.

incremental-replay.description: Incremental model and its replay: unique key, late-arriving data, reprocessing window, idempotence, full refresh.

bigquery-cost-review.description: BigQuery cost measured before and after: bytes, partitions, clustering, slots, frequency, budget.

perimeter-brief.description: HTML brief of a Data perimeter from a dbt repo, quiz and candidate glossary terms; first lesson of /learn.

verify-change.description: Replaced in 0.2.0 by tdd and mr.

java-change.description: Develop or review a Java feature in an existing repo (Maven or Gradle, Spring or other).

infra-change.description: Prepare or review an infrastructure or delivery change: Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD pipeline, Dockerfile, cloud configuration.

architecture-decision.description: Investigate and document an architecture decision (ADR): options, criteria, consequences, reversibility.
